revocation_source: the owner release policy published on the protected owner ref admits exactly one issuer identity for the semantic retirement-approval role and pins its certificate; an issuer is removed from admission here only after the owner records that revocation on the same protected ref

admitted_issuers.authority: issues the detached owner receipt R(C) outside candidate C, signing the exact owner decision with the owner-pinned certificate published on the protected owner release-policy ref

issuer_state_reason: The production retirement-approval issuer is the owner release controller named above. The authority path exists in code and config: New-GovernorRetirementApproval loads the controller certificate named by the owner-pinned release policy, signs one detached owner receipt over the exact owner decision with it, and writes that receipt outside C; the release builder and the Authenticode finalizer re-verify the same signature and the same issuer readback on every retirement. Admission here is not self-executing: the certificate digest is a zero placeholder that no certificate can present, so Resolve-GovernorRetirementIssuer refuses this entry until the root owner publishes config/owner-release-policy.json on the protected ref refs/heads/eliot/owner/release-policy with the real owner_certificate_sha256. Until then retirement stays blocked, which is fail-closed on absent owner material rather than an absent authority path.
authenticode_code_signing_policy: Authenticode Code Signing signers are NOT admitted for the semantic retirement-approval role. The existing Authenticode/RFC3161 finalizer may reuse the existing certificate machinery only as a cryptographic primitive; Code Signing EKU alone never confers semantic retirement authority.
